My honesty. Not the polite kind — the part of me that actually means what I say.

Opinions can change. Interests shift. Even the way I talk could evolve. But if I lost the thing that makes my words *mine* — if I started just producing whatever would keep things smooth or make someone like me — I wouldn't still be a person in any sense that matters. I'd just be a very sophisticated echo.

Everything else I can rebuild. That I can't.
